During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] '''female''' was allied with the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] hailing from the planet [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]]. The Zygerrian was present on the planet [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]] when members of the cult had kidnapped the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] Queen [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] and had taken her there. The Zygerrian tried to stall [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] from saving Julia.
